user.title: Zeitwerk
user.description: Set up Zeitwerk – weekly schedules with profiles and overrides.

apply.name: Apply current profile
apply.description: Runs the actions of the plan's current profile now.

set_profile_value.name: Set profile value
set_profile_value.description: Changes the value of a profile's action (e.g. Comfort to 21 °C).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id, e.g. comfort (all profiles: attribute profiles of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile or service get_plan).

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Target entity, if the profile has several actions.

key.name: Key
key.description: Data key to change (default: value, temperature, option, …).

skip_next.name: Skip next change
skip_next.description: Keeps the current profile until the change after next.

force_profile.name: Force profile
force_profile.description: Forces a profile for a duration (default: until the next change).

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id, e.g. comfort (all profiles: attribute profiles of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile or service get_plan).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the profile is forced.

clear_force.name: Clear forced profile
clear_force.description: Ends a forced or skipped profile and returns to the schedule.

get_plan.name: Get plan
get_plan.description: Returns one or all plans as response data: profiles (id, name, actions), default profile, day plan per weekday under 'days' (mon…sun, plus holiday if used; blocks start/end/profile, never across midnight), overrides (top = highest priority), activation, holidays, options and the current status (active profile, source, next change). Basics: a plan sets profiles by a week plan; outside all blocks the default profile applies; a matching override replaces the week plan; if the activation is not met the plan is paused.

set_day_plan.name: Set day plan
set_day_plan.description: Sets exactly these blocks on the given days (their previous blocks are replaced; other days stay unchanged). Blocks stay within one day: start < end, format HH:MM, end at most 24:00, no overlaps. Outside the blocks the default profile applies; an empty list makes the whole day default. 'holiday' only exists with holiday mode 'own_day_type'. Requires admin.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id, e.g. wohnzimmer_heizung (see attribute plan_id of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile).

days.name: Days
days.description: List of mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun, holiday.

blocks.name: Blocks
blocks.description: List of {start: 'HH:MM', end: 'HH:MM', profile: '<profile id>'}, e.g. [{start: '06:00', end: '08:00', profile: 'comfort'}].

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Creates or changes an override. An override replaces the week plan with its profile while its conditions apply (e.g. geofencing helper 'nobody home' on → profile away). Order is priority, position 0 = top. Without a known override_id a new override is created (name, profile and conditions required); with an existing id only the given fields change. Conditions use the Home Assistant format (condition: state/numeric_state/time/…). Note: 'for:' in conditions is not re-checked after the delay – implement delays in the helper or the geofencing automation. Requires admin.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id, e.g. wohnzimmer_heizung (see attribute plan_id of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile).

override_id.name: Override id
override_id.description: Id of an existing override (see get_plan or the overrides attribute) or a new id.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile id that applies while the override matches.

match.name: Match
match.description: all = all conditions must apply, any = at least one.

position.name: Position
position.description: 0 = highest priority. If omitted the position is kept (new overrides go last).

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id, e.g. wohnzimmer_heizung (see attribute plan_id of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile).

override_id.name: Override id
override_id.description: Id of the override to remove.

update_plan.name: Update plan
update_plan.description: Changes parts of a plan; only given fields change. activation, holidays and options are merged with the existing values, profiles replaces the profile list. Activation: {match: all|any, conditions: [...], when_inactive: none | profile:<id>, reevaluate: true|false} – if not met the plan is paused. Holidays: {source: calendar.* or binary_sensor.* (Workday), mode: off|like_day|own_day_type, like_day: mon…sun, day_type: <id>}. Options: {reapply_on_start, reapply_on_profile_change, manual_override: until_next|ignore|minutes:<n>}. Profile: {id, name, color, icon, actions: [Home Assistant actions]}. Requires admin.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id, e.g. wohnzimmer_heizung (see attribute plan_id of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile).

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: List of tags (for the timeline card).

default_profile.name: Default profile
default_profile.description: Profile id that applies outside all blocks.

activation.name: Activation
activation.description: Conditions whether the plan runs at all.

create_plan.name: Create plan
create_plan.description: Creates a new plan (full plan object as in get_plan without 'days' and 'status'; 'week' with day_types) and returns the new plan_id. At least name, profiles and default_profile. Requires admin.

delete_plan.name: Delete plan
delete_plan.description: Deletes a plan and its entities permanently. Requires admin.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Plan id, e.g. wohnzimmer_heizung (see attribute plan_id of sensor.zeitwerk_<plan>_profile).

missing_entities.title: Zeitwerk plan "{plan}" refers to missing entities
missing_entities.description:
The plan "{plan}" uses entities that do not exist (any more): {entities}.

Actions or conditions with these entities fail. Restore the entities or edit the plan in the Zeitwerk card. This message disappears once all entities exist again.
